form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES

action.action-desc: Mr. Durbin (for himself, Ms. Hirono, Mr. Markey, Ms. Duckworth, Ms. Klobuchar, and Ms. Smith) introduced the following bill; which was read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation

form.official-title: To expand the private right of action under the Telephone Consumer Protection Act for calls in violation of the Do Not Call rules.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Protecting American Consumers from Robocalls Act.

section.header: Private right of action for calls in violation of Do Not Call rules
section.text: Section 227(c)(5) of the Communications Act of 1934 (47 U.S.C. 227(c)(5)) is amended—

paragraph.text: in the matter preceding subparagraph (A), by striking more than one telephone call within any 12-month period by or on behalf of the same entity and inserting a telephone call by or on behalf of an entity; and
in subparagraph (B), by striking up to.
